intro: Between May 7 and May 16, 2026, ZCyberNews published five articles on integer-overflow vulnerabilities, featuring high-severity CVEs CVE-2026-43908, CVE-2026-8573, and CVE-2026-8577, each with a CVSS score of 8.8. The coverage also included CVE-2026-44636 (CVSS 7.8) and CVE-2026-43996 (CVSS 5.5). The affected sectors spanned animation, media and entertainment, technology, visual effects, and all industries globally, with a severity mix of three high, one medium, and one critical issue.
